narrative.details:
I have placed the Sepulcher's supplies into this crate.  If you have already visited the Sepulcher and spoken with their bat master, then you may ride a bat back to him.

Speak with the Undercity's bat master, Michael Garrett.  He can provide you with a bat to the Sepulcher.
narrative.objectives: Bring Gordon's Crate to Michael Garrett.
narrative.offerRewardText: This crate must reach the Sepulcher in Silverpine? That is easily done; our bats fly there daily.
narrative.requestItemsText: If you must travel a long distance, then a bat is your best option.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests at level 10, 1,890 XP in all.

quests.name: Supplying the Sepulcher
quests.objectiveText: Bring Podrig's Order to Karos Razok.

quests.name: Ride to the Undercity
quests.objectiveText: Buy a bat ride to the Undercity from the bat master Karos Razok, then take Podrig's Order to Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.

quests.name: Michael Garrett
quests.objectiveText: Bring Gordon's Crate to Michael Garrett.

quests.name: Return to Podrig
quests.objectiveText: Buy a bat ride to the Sepulcher from the bat master Michael Garrett, then bring Gordon's Crate to Deathguard Podrig in the Sepulcher.
